annotations.text:
Read left to right, top to bottom.
1 Overview  2 World stub  3 GM configures components  4 Player builds against that config.
Wireframe fidelity, real site tokens. World content is ghosted on purpose: v1 ships it as a stub.
Two Hit points components on one config, one Number and one Weighted scale, to prove cardinality and representation are the GM's call, never the app's.
